turns.text: Good to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I need help choosing a holiday gift for my wife.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll describe them all, so please hold off until I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first idea is a weekend at a little cabin in the mountains, just the two of us.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's a really nice leather bag she looked at twice but didn't buy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last option is a pottery class for both of us, every Thursday for a month.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So those are the options. What's your take?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The cabin weekend and the pottery class are both about spending time together, which often means more than an object. The bag is a safe bet since she clearly wanted it. If she's been busy and tired lately, the cabin might be the best gift of all.
